summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: The npm postinstall script scripts/platform-bootstrap.mjs downloads a platform-specific tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP URL (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz), extracts it into node_modules, hardlinks the extracted binary into bin/.onecode, and chmods it 0755 so it runs when the package's bin entry is invoked. The HTTPS request is issued with `rejectUnauthorized: false`, disabling certificate validation, and no hash or signature is checked on the downloaded bytes. The redirect handler re-invokes downloadFile for 301/302 responses without restoring certificate validation, so any redirected host is also fetched without TLS checks. The fetch source is a raw IPv4 endpoint rather than a publisher-controlled, DNS-named domain, and the delivered bytes are executed on the installer's host on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
